Troubleshooting provider failures

Provider failures are usually caused by malformed credentials, temporary upstream throttling, or invalid JSON returned by a model that ignored the requested response shape.

The recommended recovery path is to keep the batch small, preserve deterministic prompt instructions, and surface a typed translation error so the popup can explain what failed.

Long knowledge-base entries should still resolve as a single article root even when the page includes side navigation, related links, and multiple utility callouts.

Regression fixtures for readability extraction help ensure future algorithm changes do not accidentally classify support content as a generic page or choose a navigation wrapper.
